newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Balikpapan refinery to start around July.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Balikpapan refinery to start around July.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina said on Thursday it would start its new 60,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) capacity Balikpapan refinery at the end of June or in early July.

"According to our plan, we will start the refinery at the end of June or in early July. At the moment we are testing the equipment there, including the pumps," Samto Utomo, Pertamina's junior processing director, told Reuters.
He said the refinery has a crude distillation unit with 60,000 bpd capacity and a high vacuum unit with capacity of 35,000 bpd.
Pertamina currently has two refineries in Balikpapan. One has a 200,000 bpd capacity and the other a 50,000 bpd capacity.
